entities.summary: Xiangtan University is a provincial public university in Xiangtan, Hunan, China. It is affiliated with the province of Hunan, and co-funded by the Hunan Provincial People's Government, the Ministry of Education of China, and SASTIND. The university is part of the Double First-Class Construction.
